_comment: Per-product Archetype-N enhancement params NOT derivable from iron-products.json. 'brand' is the display casing used in JSON-LD and prose (note it can differ from the namespace/assembly casing, e.g. brand 'IronBarcode' vs assembly 'IronBarCode.dll'). 'assembly' is the .dll the structural-orientation FAQ cites. 'doc_root' is an OPTIONAL absolute or repo-relative path to that product's how-to/examples/tutorials markdown for funnel-link discovery + on-disk verification; empty string = degraded mode (links are generated from site URL patterns and validated for format/count but not on-disk existence). base_url and product_url are derived at runtime from the iron-products.json domain+path: base_url = https://{domain}{path}/object-reference/api/, product_url = https://{domain}{path}/.
